title: Troubleshoot VPN authentication failures
content: If VPN authentication fails, verify the device date and time, confirm the user account is active, and reconnect using the current VPN profile. If multi-factor approval is pending, open the authenticator app and approve the sign-in. After repeated failures, reset the VPN password and contact Network Support. Do not ask users to share passwords or MFA codes.

title: Reset an expired password
content: Use the company password reset portal to set a new password that meets the current policy. Sign out and back in to refresh credentials. If self-service reset is unavailable or the account is locked, route the request to Identity and Access Support. Never collect a user's current password.

title: Unlock a company account
content: Confirm the employee identity through the approved verification workflow, then unlock the account in the identity portal. Ask the employee to update saved credentials on managed devices. Escalate repeated lockouts to Identity and Access Support for investigation.

title: Resolve Outlook synchronization issues
content: Check network connectivity and Microsoft 365 service health first. Restart Outlook and verify the mailbox is not over quota. If sync remains delayed, create a fresh Outlook profile through the approved support procedure and escalate persistent service-side issues to Collaboration Support.

title: Improve slow laptop performance
content: Restart the device, check available disk space, and close unnecessary applications. Install pending updates from the managed software center. Do not disable endpoint protection. If performance remains poor, collect device diagnostics and route to Endpoint Support.

title: Install approved software
content: Request software through the employee service portal. Select an item from the approved software catalog and provide a business justification if prompted. The request is routed for required approval before deployment to the managed device.

title: Reconnect to office Wi-Fi
content: Confirm Wi-Fi is enabled and connect to the corporate network using the managed device profile. Forget and rejoin the network only if the profile is current. Guest Wi-Fi is not for accessing internal resources. Escalate persistent connectivity issues to Network Support.
